strings.long_src: We're near Ivan Rodriguez's home.

strings.en: По данным Гауди, это где-то здесь.
strings.long_src: According to Gaudi's records, it￥should be around here.

strings.en_src: No zoning work has reached￥this area.
strings.long_src: This area hasn't seen much￥redevelopment.

strings.en: Поэтому у нейрокомпьютера Нео-Кобе,￥"Альфавиля", о нём нет данных.
strings.en_src: That's why Neo Kobe's neural￥computer, Alphaville, has no records￥of it.

strings.long_src: It's completely outside the￥information management system.
Board Tricycle
The third floor. He can't escape￥through a window.
strings.long: Третий этаж. Через окно не сбежит.

strings.long_src: Building

strings.en: Похоже, за домом никто не следит.￥Полное запустение.
strings.en_src: No maintenance either, by the￥look. Wholly abandoned.
strings.long_src: It doesn't look as if anyone￥maintains the place. It's been￥completely neglected.

strings.en_src: This place is filthy. There are a￥few Freemen here.

strings.long_src: Neo Kobe's north-south divide is￥plain to see here.
strings.long: Здесь разрыв между севером и югом￥Нео-Кобе как на ладони.

strings.en: Похоже, бездомные, живут одним днём.￥Собрались у костра.
strings.en_src: Day-to-day vagrants, 'home-less',￥it seems.￥They gather at the fire.
strings.long_src: They seem to be homeless people,￥living from day to day. They're￥gathered around a fire.

strings.en_src: They flee managed society for￥a free life.￥One of our age's ills.
strings.long_src: They reject our regulated society￥and advocate living freely. It's one￥of the problems of modern society.
strings.long: Они отвергают наше регулируемое￥общество и проповедуют свободную￥жизнь. Одна из проблем￥современности.

strings.long_src: Bonfire

strings.en: Набивают в бочку всё, что горит, и￥жгут.
strings.long_src: They're stuffing everything they can￥into an oil drum and burning it.
The nights get cold this time of￥year.
strings.long: В это время года ночи холодные.

strings.en_src: I hope it starts no fire.
strings.long_src: I hope they don't start a fire.
Investigate

strings.en_src: It seems safe. The structure is￥sound.
Altered here and there.￥Against building code.
strings.long_src: Parts of it have been altered. Those￥changes violate the building code.
The government officially recognizes￥this as a slum. It's exempt from￥centralized information control.
strings.long: Правительство официально признаёт￥это трущобами. Район исключён из￥централизованного контроля￥информации.

strings.long_src: These cars look abandoned, not just￥illegally parked.
strings.long: Эти машины, похоже, не просто￥неправильно припаркованы, а брошены.

strings.en: Похоже, в них живут многие, так что￥убирают их медленно.
strings.en_src: Many live inside them, so￥removal never progresses.
strings.long_src: Many people seem to live in them, so￥removing them has been slow work.

strings.en: По данным тут не определишь, кто где￥живёт.
strings.en_src: There's no way to tell who lives￥where from the records.

strings.long_src: What? You want me to search them?
That's right.
Search them thoroughly!
Hey! What the hell are you doing?
strings.long: Эй! Ты что творишь, чёрт возьми?

strings.en_src: I found nothing suspicious. Just a￥lot of grime.

strings.long_src: ＠赤Grime＠白 doesn't pay!

strings.en_src: Gillian! Please stop making those￥awful jokes.

strings.long_src: Hmm. Something smells.

strings.en: При них ничего нет. Мой нос больше￥не выдержит.
strings.en_src: They have nothing on them. My nose￥can't take any more.
You don't even have a nose.
I mean my sensors are about to￥malfunction.
strings.long: Я имею в виду, что мои сенсоры￥вот-вот откажут.

strings.en_src: Be careful. Some of that smoke is￥toxic.
They burn anything at all.￥The cars round here will burn￥one day too.
strings.long_src: That's what happens when you burn￥everything. They'll probably burn￥these cars someday too.
strings.long: Вот что бывает, когда жгут всё￥подряд. Когда-нибудь они и эти￥машины сожгут.

strings.en_src: Wait. There are lots of syringes in￥the ashes.
I'm detecting Liquid Sky. It's a￥narcotic.

strings.en: Наверное, у них тут горит весь день.
strings.en_src: They probably keep it burning all￥day.

strings.en: Он живёт тут, в ＠黄квартире 301＠白. Парень￥помешан на какой-то доске.
strings.en_src: He lives in ＠黄'room 301'＠白 here.￥A lad mad for some sort of board.
strings.long_src: He lives in ＠黄apartment 301＠白 here. The￥kid's crazy about some kind of￥board.

strings.en_src: You mean a siphon, don't you?

strings.long_src: I can't make much sense of this￥conversation.
strings.long: Ничего не понимаю в этом разговоре.

strings.long_src: He seems to have come into some￥money lately.
strings.long: Похоже, у него в последнее время￥завелись деньги.

strings.en_src: That one... I can't figure him.
strings.long_src: I've never really understood that￥kid.
strings.long: Никогда я этого парня толком не￥понимал.

strings.en: Кстати, ты в прошлый раз видел￥Ивана?
strings.en_src: By the by... did you meet Ivan￥the other day?
strings.long_src: By the way, did you manage to see￥Ivan last time?

strings.en_src: Can you tell me about a man named￥Ivan Rodriguez?
strings.long: Можете рассказать о человеке по￥имени Иван Родригес?

strings.long_src: Do we know anyone by that name?
You'll regret it if you lie to me!

strings.en: Ну-ну, не надо так. Я вспоминаю.
strings.en_src: Now, don't be like that. I'm trying￥to remember.

strings.long_src: I think I've seen him somewhere.
They're obviously messing with us.

strings.en_src: Why not show him the montage photo?
strings.long_src: Why don't you show them the￥composite photo?

strings.en: Понятия не имею. Я теперь и своё имя￥еле помню.
strings.en_src: No idea... I can't recall￥my own name now.
strings.long_src: No idea. These days I can barely￥remember my own name.
Heard any rumors about Snatchers￥around here?

strings.en: Даже снатчер на таких, как мы, не￥позарится.
strings.en_src: Even a Snatcher wouldn't snatch the￥likes of us.

strings.en: Здесь нет никого, кто стоил бы их￥внимания.
strings.en_src: Nobody here is worth enough for them￥to bother with.
Nobody here is scared of them.

strings.long_src: How long have you been here?

strings.en: Когда-то я был системным инженером в￥команде, создавшей "Альфавиль".
strings.en_src: I used to be a systems engineer on￥the team that designed Alphaville.

strings.long_src: A programmer? How did you end up￥here?

strings.en_src: One day, I took a peek at the data￥inside Alphaville.
For me it was possible... so I￥saw a lifetime of the filth in￥men and society.
strings.long_src: It wasn't for me. I saw enough of￥the ugly side of people and society￥to last a lifetime.
strings.long: Для меня - возможно. Я увидел￥столько грязи людей и общества, что￥хватит на всю жизнь.

strings.en: Люди немногого стоят, как бы ни￥важничали.
strings.en_src: People are dull things,￥for all their swagger.
strings.long_src: People aren't worth much, however￥important they act.

strings.en: Почему бы тебе не стать фрименом?￥Приходи, когда всё надоест.
strings.en_src: Come be a free man yourself?￥When you tire of it, come along.
strings.long_src: Why don't you join us and become a￥Freeman? Come by whenever you've had￥enough.

strings.en_src: To be free... I must take back￥my past.
strings.long_src: I'll have to get my past back before￥I can be free.
strings.long: Чтобы стать свободным, мне нужно￥вернуть своё прошлое.

strings.en_src: Well, Alphaville has records on us￥developers. Look us up next time you￥access it.
strings.long: Что ж, в "Альфавиле" есть данные о￥нас, разработчиках. Загляни, когда￥будешь туда заходить.

strings.en_src: How long do you plan to stay here?
Not like him. I want work.￥I'm willing but there's no job.
strings.long_src: Unlike him, I want a job. I'm￥willing to work, but there's no work￥for me.
strings.long: Я, в отличие от него, хочу работать.￥Готов работать, но работы для меня￥нет.

strings.long_src: You don't have an ID, do you?

strings.en_src: Aye.￥No job centre for me.￥Come on, give me work.
strings.long_src: That's right. I can't even go to the￥employment office. Come on, give me￥a job.
strings.long: Точно. Даже на биржу труда не￥сходишь. Ну дай работу, а?

strings.long_src: An immigrant?

strings.en: Я въехал нелегально. Ехал в этот￥город с мечтами. А теперь посмотри￥на меня.
strings.en_src: I came in illegally. I had dreams￥when I came to this city. Look at me￥now.

strings.long_src: What about you?

strings.en: Я? Я сам решил исчезнуть. Надоели￥семья и фирма.
strings.en_src: Me? I vanished of my own will.￥Sick of family and company.
strings.long_src: Me? I chose to disappear. I got sick￥of my family and my company.

strings.en: Здесь я снова как ребёнок. Каждое￥утро просыпаюсь и думаю: "Чем бы￥сегодня заняться?"
strings.en_src: Here it's like being a child￥again. I wake and always think:￥'what shall I do today?'...
strings.long_src: Being here makes me feel like a kid￥again. Every morning I wake up and￥wonder, "What should I do today?"

strings.en: Ни расписаний, ни оков. Каждый день￥- чистый лист.
strings.en_src: No schedule, no shackles. Every￥day's a blank page.
strings.long_src: No schedules, nothing tying me down.￥Every day is a blank page.
What about that old man?

strings.en: А, его сын с невесткой здесь￥бросили.
strings.en_src: Oh, his son and daughter-in-law￥dumped him here.

strings.long_src: It's that whole problem with care￥for the elderly.
strings.long: Это всё проблема ухода за стариками.

strings.en_src: Nursing fees unpaid, the hospital￥put him out. Then his son￥dumped him here.
strings.long_src: He couldn't pay for his care, so the￥hospital threw him out. His son and￥daughter-in-law brought him here and￥abandoned him.
strings.long: Он не мог платить за уход, и￥больница его выгнала. Сын с￥невесткой привезли его сюда и￥бросили.

strings.long_src: A dumping ground for old people, I￥guess.

strings.en_src: We look after him. Even after what￥they did, he still calls his son's￥name at night.
strings.long: Мы за ним присматриваем. После￥всего, что они сделали, он всё равно￥по ночам зовёт сына.

strings.en_src: We know his son's phone number.
Would you call them for us?
Please... the old man's￥a sad case.
strings.long_src: We're counting on you. I feel so￥sorry for him.

strings.en: У них своя жизнь. Давай на этом￥остановимся.
strings.en_src: They have their own ways of living.￥Let's leave it at that.

strings.en: Ты ведь позвонил сыну старика и его￥жене?
strings.en_src: You called the old man's son￥for him, then.
strings.long_src: You called the old man's son and his￥wife, didn't you?
Did they come for him?

strings.en_src: Thank you. You're a good man.

strings.long_src: I'm glad it worked out.

strings.en_src: But Ivan is our main concern.
Let's leave it at that, Gillian.
Can you get drugs around here?

strings.en: Ага, но для нас они слишком дорогие.
strings.en_src: Yeah, but they're too expensive for￥us.
A few buyers about, it seems.
strings.long_src: Seems there are a few dealers around￥here.
It's an everyday thing here.

strings.en_src: Find him, you say... but where￥is he?
strings.long_src: You want me to find him, but I have￥no idea where he is.
strings.long: Найти-то найти, но я понятия не￥имею, где он.

strings.en_src: My records are no use here. Let's￥ask around.

strings.long_src: Let's try asking those guys.

strings.en: Давай спросим местных. Есть тут кто?
strings.en_src: Let's ask the folk about here.￥...Anyone there?
strings.long_src: Let's ask the people around here. Is￥anyone there?
Has something happened?

strings.en: Тебя жена послала вернуть меня, да?￥Так вот, я домой не пойду!
strings.en_src: My wife sent you to bring me back,￥didn't she? Well, I'm not going￥home!

strings.long_src: Find me a job, will you?
Candy
It would be wiser not to show them￥cash.

strings.en_src: Showing cash to men like these...￥only stirs them up.
strings.long_src: Showing people like this cash will￥only get them worked up.
Evidence
Scrap of paper
Chess piece
Photo

strings.en_src: A photo? It all brings back￥memories.

strings.long_src: Do you know this man?
No doubt about it. It's Ivan.
What is it?
I'd like to ask you something.
Is that for me?
Got anything to eat?
We're outside apartment 301.

strings.en: Движения не обнаружено. Похоже, его￥нет. Давай вернёмся позже, Гиллиан.
strings.en_src: No movement detected. He seems to be￥out. Let's come back later, Gillian.

strings.en: Никакого движения. Его нет. Давай￥вернёмся позже.
strings.en_src: No motion response at all.￥Out, then... let's come again.
strings.long_src: I'm detecting no movement at all.￥He's out. Let's come back later.

strings.en_src: No help for it.￥Home to your place for a rest?
strings.long_src: There's nothing we can do. Why don't￥we go back to your place for a￥break?
strings.long: Ничего не поделаешь. Может, вернёмся￥к тебе домой передохнуть?

strings.long_src: You've been working a little too￥hard.
Yeah. That's a good idea.

strings.en_src: Ring your wife now and then?
strings.long_src: Why don't you give your wife a call￥for a change?

strings.en_src: No help for it.￥Off to Gibson's house...
strings.long_src: There's nothing we can do here.￥Let's go to Gibson's house.
strings.long: Тут ничего не поделаешь. Поехали к￥Гибсону домой.

strings.en_src: We could find out a little more￥about Gibson.

strings.long_src: Someone's inside. Let's investigate.
Are we just going to leave?
We have no choice. Let's come back￥later.
That's strange.

strings.en_src: It's an old door with a peephole.
A man peers from beyond it.￥Ivan, perhaps?
strings.long_src: A man is looking out through it.￥Could that be Ivan?

strings.en_src: Peer from inside and an eye￥shows.
strings.long_src: If someone looks through from￥inside, we should be able to see his￥eye.
strings.long: Если кто-то посмотрит изнутри, мы￥должны увидеть его глаз.

strings.en_src: There is an electric meter.￥This room's, no doubt.
strings.long_src: There's an electricity meter. It￥probably belongs to this apartment.

strings.en_src: A small window by the door.
strings.long_src: There's a small window beside the￥door.
The apartments on either side seem￥empty.
Power meter

strings.en_src: An old-style power meter. It￥shows usage in visible form.
strings.long_src: It's an old electricity meter. It￥has a display showing how much power￥is being used.
strings.long: Старый электросчётчик. На дисплее￥видно, сколько расходуется энергии.

strings.en_src: A power meter. Outside the data￥area, power is collected￥by hand.
strings.long_src: It's an electricity meter. Since￥this area is outside the data￥network, someone apparently comes to￥collect payment.
strings.long: Электросчётчик. Район вне сети￥данных, так что, видимо, кто-то￥приходит собирать плату.

strings.long_src: Window
Something's stuck over the inside,￥so I can't see in.
strings.long: Изнутри что-то наклеено, не видно,￥что внутри.

strings.en: Даже не понять, горит ли свет.
strings.en_src: We can't even tell if the lights are￥on.
The plate for room 301.￥Handwritten, but no mistake.
strings.long_src: It's the plate for apartment 301.￥The name is handwritten, but this is￥definitely the place.
strings.long: Табличка квартиры 301. Имя написано￥от руки, но это точно здесь.

strings.long_src: Without a warrant, we can't open it￥unless we have a key.
strings.long: Без ордера открыть её можно только￥ключом.

strings.long_src: Hmm? Electricity is being used!
Movement detected! Someone appears￥to be inside.

strings.en_src: As the meter showed, someone￥was in.
strings.long_src: Someone was inside, just as the￥meter suggested.
strings.long: Внутри кто-то был, как и показывал￥счётчик.

strings.en_src: No living-level power use.￥Nobody seems to be in.
strings.long_src: Power usage is below normal￥household levels. No one seems to be￥home.
strings.long: Расход энергии ниже бытового уровня.￥Похоже, никого нет дома.

strings.en_src: It is locked.￥Shut for a long while, it seems.
strings.long_src: It's locked. It looks as if it's￥been shut for a long time.

strings.en_src: It's too small for us to get￥through.
At a time like this? Later.
strings.long_src: This is a critical moment. Let's do￥that later.

strings.en_src: This is no time to use the￥videophone.

strings.en: Иван Родригес! ДЖАНКЕР! У нас есть￥вопросы. Открывай!
strings.en_src: Ivan Rodriguez! JUNKER! We have some￥questions. Open the door!

strings.long_src: What's this all about?

strings.en_src: All right, all right! Don't get so￥worked up.

strings.en: Будь осторожен, понял? Это не то,￥что драться с инсекторами.
strings.en_src: Listen, be careful.￥This isn't like the Insector.
strings.long_src: Be careful, understand? This won't￥be like fighting the Insectors.

strings.en_src: I know. I don't want to need those￥nanomachines again.

strings.long_src: Sorry for the wait...

strings.en_src: No mistake.￥This is Ivan Rodriguez's room.
strings.long_src: No doubt about it. This is Ivan￥Rodriguez's apartment.

strings.en_src: He looks just like the composite￥photo! But he's very tanned.
Could he be a Snatcher with a tan￥like that?

strings.long_src: Inside
It's dark in here. I don't see￥anything particularly suspicious.
strings.long: Темно тут. Ничего особо￥подозрительного не вижу.

strings.en: Ну и грязная комната. О! Там￥какой-то кубок.
strings.en_src: What a filthy room. Oh! There's a￥trophy over there.

strings.long_src: This room looks filthy no matter how￥many times I look.
Gun

strings.en_src: A cheap raygun off the black￥market.
strings.long_src: It's a cheap ray gun sold on the￥black market.

strings.en: Тут написано: "Второе место, 12-й￥чемпионат Нео-Кобе по аэросёрфингу".

strings.en_src: Not stolen; his own,￥by the look.
strings.long_src: It seems to be his own trophy, not￥stolen.

strings.en: Без ＠赤ордера на сканирование＠白￥тщательный осмотр невозможен.
strings.en_src: We can't do a thorough examination￥without a ＠赤scanning warrant＠白.

strings.en: На первый взгляд, несмотря на загар,￥признаков рака нет.
strings.en_src: At first glance, there's no sign of￥cancer despite his tan.
No black tumours on the skin.
strings.long_src: There are no black tumors on his￥skin.

strings.en_src: For safety I checked the surface￥sphingoglycolipid groups too.￥No mutation.
strings.long_src: To be safe, I checked the functional￥glycosphingolipid macromolecules on￥his cell surfaces. There are no￥mutations.
strings.long: На всякий случай я проверил￥функциональные гликосфинголипиды на￥поверхности его клеток. Мутаций нет.

strings.en_src: His skin has a healthy tan.

strings.en: По коже не скажешь, что он снатчер.
strings.long_src: There's no evidence in his skin that￥he's a Snatcher.

strings.en_src: Much dust in the old static￥collector.￥Not a tidy sort, it seems.
strings.long_src: The old electrostatic collector is￥full of dust. He doesn't seem to￥like cleaning.
strings.long: Старый электростатический￥пылесборник забит пылью. Уборку он,￥похоже, не любит.

strings.en: Реакции на снежный кедр тоже нет.￥Следов снатчера в комнате не вижу.
strings.en_src: No reaction to Snow Cedar, either. I￥see no evidence of a Snatcher in￥this room.

strings.en: "Сатердей Найт RG-11". Переделанный￥пистолет, такой даже у детей бывает.
strings.en_src: A Saturday Night RG-11. It's a￥modified gun even kids can get hold￥of.
Gillian, a weak gun. Lucky￥for you.
strings.long_src: You're lucky it wasn't a powerful￥gun, Gillian.
strings.long: Тебе повезло, что пушка была слабой,￥Гиллиан.

strings.long_src: It could have been worse, Gillian.
I took four hits, but I'll be fine￥if that's all it can do.
strings.long: Четыре попадания, но если это всё,￥что она может, я в порядке.

strings.long_src: Gillian, with a gun like this,
I should be fine even after three￥hits.

strings.en: Не волнуйся, Гиллиан. При такой￥слабой мощности
strings.en_src: Don't worry, Gillian. With this￥little firepower,
Yeah, even two hits are nothing.

strings.long_src: Your injuries are minor, Gillian.
